label: Designing Data-Intensive Applications: The Big Ideas Behind Reliable, Scalable, and Maintainable Systems
description: Explores the fundamental trade-offs in data storage and processing technologies. Covers data models, storage engines (LSM-trees vs B-trees), encoding formats, replication (single-leader, multi-leader, leaderless), partitioning, transactions (ACID vs serializability), and distributed stream processing.

label: Domain-Driven Design: Tackling Complexity in the Heart of Software

label: Clean Architecture: A Craftsman's Guide to Software Structure and Design
description: Details architectural boundaries, SOLID design principles, component cohesion, and the Dependency Rule (source code dependencies must point inward toward higher-level policies).

label: Refactoring UI

label: The Visual Display of Quantitative Information

label: The Hero with a Thousand Faces

Argues that successful myth creates a Secondary World commanding Secondary Belief through complete internal coherence.

label: 7 Powers: The Foundations of Business Strategy

label: Antifragile: Things That Gain from Disorder
description: Introduces the Triad (Fragile - Robust - Antifragile). Argues that fragile entities break under volatility, robust entities resist, while antifragile entities grow stronger. Details Via Negativa (subtractive knowledge), Convexity (more upside than downside), and Skin in the Game.

label: Thinking with Type

description: Long-running multi-day swarms generate millions of tokens; without static KV cache alignment and prompt compaction, inference costs scale non-linearly.

label: In-Memory Knowledge Graph Scaling Thresholds
description: Flat JSON AST trees become unwieldy past 2,000 entities, requiring transition to columnar disk-backed stores (LanceDB/Kùzu) and localized subgraph partitioning.

label: Attention Is All You Need
description: The dominant sequence transduction models are based on complex recurrent or convolutional neural networks. We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer, based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely.

label: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners (GPT-3)
description: We train GPT-3, an autoregressive language model with 175 billion parameters, and test its few-shot performance across NLP tasks. GPT-3 achieves strong performance on many benchmarks, often matching or exceeding the performance of fine-tuned models.

label: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior
description: We introduce generative agents—computational software agents that simulate believable human behavior. Generative agents draw on an architecture that extends a large language model to store a complete record of the agent's experiences using natural language, synthesize those memories over time into higher-level reflections, and retrieve them dynamically to plan behavior.

label: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
description: We present Reflexion, an approach that endows an agent with dynamic memory and self-reflection capabilities for reasoning, decision-making, and programming tasks. Reflexion agents verbally reflect on task feedback signals, then maintain their own reflective text in an episodic memory buffer to induce better decision-making in subsequent trials.

label: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
description: We explore the use of LLMs to generate both reasoning traces and task-specific actions in an interleaved manner, allowing for greater synergy between the two: reasoning traces help the model induce, track, and update action plans as well as handle exceptions, while actions allow it to interface with and gather additional information from external sources.

label: DSPy: Compiling Declarative Language Model Calls
description: We present DSPy, a framework for programming with foundation models that separates the flow of your program (modules) from the parameters (prompts and weights) of each step. DSPy synthesizes and optimizes prompts based on a pipeline specification and training examples.

label: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models
description: We introduce Voyager, the first LLM-powered embodied lifelong learning agent in Minecraft that continuously explores the world, acquires diverse skills, and makes novel discoveries without human intervention. Voyager consists of an automatic curriculum, a skill library of executable code, and an iterative prompting mechanism.

label: Toolformer: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Use Tools
description: We introduce Toolformer, a model trained to decide which APIs to call, when to call them, what arguments to pass, and how to best incorporate the results into future token prediction. This is done in a self-supervised way, requiring only a handful of human demonstrations.

label: MemGPT: Towards LLMs as Operating Systems
description: Large language models are constrained by finite context windows. We present MemGPT (Memory-GPT), a system that intelligently manages different memory tiers in LLMs to effectively provide extended context within the LLM's limited context window, drawing inspiration from hierarchical memory management in operating systems.

label: DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
description: We introduce our first-generation reasoning models, DeepSeek-R1-Zero and DeepSeek-R1. DeepSeek-R1-Zero, a model trained via large-scale reinforcement learning without supervised fine-tuning (SFT) as a preliminary step, demonstrates remarkable reasoning capabilities. Through RL, DeepSeek-R1-Zero naturally emerges with numerous powerful and intriguing reasoning behaviors.

label: Constitutional AI: A Framework for Machine Learning with Principles
description: We introduce Constitutional AI (CAI), a method for training a harmless AI assistant through self-improvement, without human feedback labels for harmfulness. The only human oversight is provided through a list of rules or principles, forming a constitution.

label: The Hallmarks of Aging
description: Aging is characterized by a progressive loss of physiological integrity, leading to impaired function and increased vulnerability to death. We enumerate and describe the hallmarks of aging.

label: Sleep and Cognitive Performance Research
description: Sleep plays a critical role in cognitive performance, memory consolidation, and health. This body of work establishes the mechanisms and consequences of sleep insufficiency.

label: Fundamentals of Astrodynamics (Bate, Mueller, White)
description: A classic introduction to astrodynamics covering the two-body problem, orbital elements, orbital maneuvers, and preliminary orbit determination.

label: Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Problem Solving with Large Language Models
description: Yao et al. paradigm enabling language models to explore multiple reasoning paths, self-evaluate intermediate choices, and perform lookahead or backtracking when problem solving.

label: Train a Basic Neural Network
description: Implement, train, and evaluate a feedforward neural network from scratch using a modern deep learning framework.

label: Implement a Transformer
description: Build a transformer architecture from scratch: multi-head attention, positional encoding, feed-forward layers, and training loop.

label: Fine-tune an LLM
description: Adapt a pretrained language model to a new task or domain using supervised fine-tuning (SFT), LoRA, or PEFT methods.

label: Evaluate an LLM
description: Design and run evaluations for language models: benchmark selection, prompt design, metric choice, and failure mode analysis.

label: Build an AI Agent
description: Design and implement an LLM-based agent with tool use, a memory strategy, and a multi-step task loop.

label: Multi-Agent Coordination
description: Design systems where multiple AI agents coordinate to complete complex tasks: orchestrators, subagents, handoffs, and shared memory.

label: Red-Team an LLM
description: Systematically probe a language model for safety failures, jailbreaks, hallucinations, and misuse vectors.

label: Evaluate Alignment
description: Design and run alignment-specific evaluations: helpfulness, harmlessness, honesty, and refusal calibration.

label: Calculate an Orbit
description: Compute orbital elements from state vectors, propagate an orbit, and analyze coverage or ground track.

label: Plan a Mission Trajectory
description: Design a mission trajectory from launch to destination, including delta-v budget, maneuver sequencing, and margin analysis.

label: Size a Propulsion System
description: Select and size a propulsion system for a given mission delta-v, spacecraft mass, and thrust requirement.

label: Design a CubeSat Mission
description: Define requirements, concept of operations, subsystem sizing, and launch vehicle selection for a 1U–12U CubeSat mission.

label: Evaluate a Longevity Intervention
description: Critically assess the evidence quality, mechanism, and translational relevance of a proposed longevity intervention.

label: Design a Cognitive Experiment
description: Design a well-controlled behavioral or cognitive experiment with defined hypotheses, measures, controls, and analysis plan.

label: Conduct a User Interview
description: Plan, conduct, and synthesize user interviews to surface jobs-to-be-done, pain points, and existing behaviors.

label: Write a Product Spec
description: Define a product or feature through a written spec: problem statement, user stories, success criteria, and non-goals.

label: Ship an MVP
description: Define, build, and launch a minimum viable product. Get it in front of real users and collect feedback.

label: Write a High-Signal Post
description: Produce a written piece that clearly communicates a non-obvious insight, earns attention from a target audience, and drives action.

label: Grow an Audience
description: Build a consistent, engaged audience through repeated high-signal content across one or more channels.

label: Build a Financial Model
description: Create a bottom-up financial model with unit economics, revenue drivers, cost structure, and scenario analysis.

label: The Santa Method (Adversarial Maker ≠ Checker)
description: A dual-agent convergence loop where a generator subagent (Fire Gate) creates the initial artifact, and an independent adversarial reviewer subagent (Crown Gate) ruthlessly audits against taste and canon until strict consensus is reached.

label: The Dreaming Reflection Engine
description: Scheduled sleep-time background agent (Letta pattern) that scans delta modifications in the vault, formulates higher-order epistemic questions, retrieves cited evidence, and generates verified reflection nodes.

label: Single Dev Server (SDS) Transient Compute
description: Policy and supervisor tool ensuring local dev servers are treated as ephemeral compute with idle TTL, keeping memory free and directing persistent reviews to Vercel previews.

label: Cross-Model Verification Shootout
description: Maker and Checker must run on different model architectures/providers to eliminate shared blindspots (e.g., Kilo free-tier generates, Codex GPT-5.6 Sol or Claude Opus audits).

label: Hierarchical Queen-Conductor-Worker Swarm
description: Decouples meta-strategic planning from task decomposition and task execution. The Queen manages the global objective, Conductor orchestrates worktrees, and Workers execute bounded tasks in parallel isolated branches.

label: Dynamic Semantic Dispatch & Model Routing
description: Routes agent tasks dynamically based on cognitive load and cost tier: fast lightweight models for mechanical lookups and scans (Shift/Flow gates); high-reasoning frontier models for architecture, judgment, and adversarial reviews (Crown/Unity gates).

label: Evaluator-Optimizer & Self-Refining Teleprompters
description: Iterative feedback loop where an Optimizer agent generates candidate prompts or code, an Evaluator agent scores against a suite of assertion tests, and teleprompter algorithms compile few-shot examples into optimized execution weights.

label: Blackboard Architecture & Shared Observable Workspace
description: A centralized, observable state repository where autonomous specialist agents read shared problem states, post intermediate discoveries, and react to changes asynchronously without tight peer-to-peer coupling.

label: Map-Reduce Parallel Swarm Scanner
description: Fan-out of dozens of lightweight scout agents to inspect distinct files, repositories, or API endpoints in parallel (Map), followed by a synthesis agent that aggregates, deduplicates, and condenses findings into a single coherent dossier (Reduce).

label: Multi-Agent Adversarial Debate & Red-Teaming
description: Two or more frontier models debate an architectural, security, or strategic proposition from opposing stances (Thesis vs Antithesis), moderated by an impartial Judge model that extracts synthesized truth (Synthesis).

label: Queue-Backed Durable Agent Worker Swarm
description: A distributed job queue (BullMQ/Redis or SQLite durable queue) decouples user request dispatch from execution. Workers pull tasks from priority queues with token rate-limit sharding, exponential backoff with jitter, and dead-letter queues for failed trajectories.

label: KV-Cache Prefix Alignment & Context Compaction
description: Maximizes provider prompt caching (Anthropic 90% discount, Gemini context caching) by structuring agent prompts with an immutable static prefix (System contract, tools schema, core lore) followed by dynamic turn deltas, reducing inference latency by 80% and token cost by 75%.

label: Hierarchical Graph Partitioning & 2-Hop Neighborhoods
description: When the knowledge graph scales past thousands of entities, agents do not ingest the whole tree. The graph is sharded into domain clusters, and agents query only the 2-hop radius around target concepts via topological traversal or semantic vector filtering.

label: Agent Sandbox Isolation & Blast Radius Containment
description: Executes untrusted code, web scraping, and third-party dependencies inside isolated lightweight containers or WASM sandboxes with restricted network access, virtualized filesystems, and strict Phone Link / root directory search bans.

label: PyTorch
description: An open-source deep learning framework for research and production. The primary tool for implementing neural networks.

label: Hugging Face Transformers
description: A library of pretrained transformer models and fine-tuning utilities. The standard toolkit for LLM practitioners.

label: Three.js & React Three Fiber
description: 3D WebGL library for rendering spatial canvases, constellations, and interactive shader environments.

label: GSAP (GreenSock Animation Platform)
description: High-performance JavaScript animation library for timeline orchestration, scroll-driven visual narratives, and UI spring dynamics.

label: Remotion
description: Framework for creating programmatic, frame-accurate MP4/WebM videos in React using web standards.

label: Suno AI Platform
description: Generative audio system producing broadcast-grade music arrangements, vocal stems, and harmonic compositions.

label: SDS (Single Dev Server Supervisor)
description: CLI supervisor managing transient local development ports with idle TTL and automatic cleanup.

label: GMAT (General Mission Analysis Tool)
description: NASA open-source space mission design and navigation tool for trajectory analysis, orbit determination, and optimization.

label: OpenRocket
description: An open-source rocket simulation software for designing and simulating model rockets.

label: Jupyter Notebook
description: An interactive computing environment for creating reproducible research notebooks combining code, text, and visualizations.

label: Notion
description: A connected workspace for documentation, product specs, databases, and company knowledge management.

label: Linear
description: A project management tool designed for software teams with fast issue tracking, cycles, and roadmaps.

label: Figma
description: Collaborative interface design and prototyping tool for design systems, vector assets, and token handoffs.

label: Framer
description: Interactive canvas and CMS publishing platform that turns design layouts directly into production React websites with fluid animations.

label: Ahrefs
description: SEO intelligence platform for backlink analysis, keyword clustering, search volume estimation, and competitor gap auditing.

label: Beehiiv
description: Newsletter platform built for sovereign creators with audience analytics, referral programs, and custom domains.

label: Stripe
description: Financial infrastructure and checkout APIs powering global subscription billing, one-click payments, and creator revenue settlement.

label: TradingView
description: Financial charting platform providing real-time market data, technical indicators, and macroeconomic asset ratio tracking.

label: LanceDB
description: Developer-friendly, serverless vector database for AI applications, written in Rust with native Node.js and Python bindings. Stores vectors and relational metadata in columnar Lance files.

label: Langfuse
description: Open source LLM engineering platform providing observability, trace visualization, prompt management, and automated evaluation metrics for multi-agent swarms.

label: BullMQ & Redis
description: High-performance, message-based distributed task queue for Node.js and TypeScript. Supports delayed jobs, parent-child task flows, rate limiting, and failure retries.

label: LiteLLM Proxy & Universal Gateway
description: High-throughput proxy server allowing 100+ LLMs in OpenAI-compatible format with built-in load balancing, fallbacks, spend tracking, and rate-limit sharding.

label: Daily Operations & Estate Sync
description: Morning synchronization workflow checking git worktree states, Linear issues, Notion Dev Hub status, storage health, and daily priority alignment.

label: ACOS Content Factory Pipeline
description: Six-stage publishing lifecycle transforming raw concepts into peer-reviewed, visually attested articles deployed to Vercel.

label: Vercel Preview Promotion Gate
description: Cloud-first workflow that enforces draft-first PRs, prevents local dev server clutter, and gates production deployment on automated Santa verification.

label: AI Architect
description: The domain of understanding, designing, and building AI systems — from mathematical foundations through large language models, agents, reasoning systems, and alignment.

label: Arcanea Worldbuilding & Mythos
description: The art and architectural doctrine of secondary creation, mythic structures, the Ten Gates, alchemical resonance frequencies, and living narrative universes.

label: Bio / Human Intelligence
description: The domain of understanding human cognition, neuroscience, longevity, performance, and biosystems — grounded in peer-reviewed science and evidence-based practice. No personal health data.

label: Content Architecture, SEO & Publishing
description: Product-led SEO, topical authority clusters, information gain scoring, high-converting copywriting, and programmatic MDX publishing workflows.

label: Creator-Founder
description: The domain of building products, companies, creative systems, and audiences — combining leverage, distribution, execution, and taste into compounding creative and commercial output.

label: Creator Strategy & High-Leverage Wealth
description: Strategic moat building, 7 Powers economic engines, antifragile venture structures, digital product publishing, and sovereign cashflow architecture.

label: Impeccable Design & Spatial Canvas
description: Design systems of the highest aesthetic standard, typographic precision, micro-interactions, quantitative data display, and spatial WebGL environments.

label: Investing, Sovereign Wealth & Capital Allocation
description: Value investing fundamentals, margin of safety, second-level thinking, macro debt cycles, barbell portfolio allocation, and permissionless compounding engines.

label: Generative Cinema, Audio & Media
description: Programmatic video rendering in React/Remotion, generative audio composition with Suno v4.5, prompt visual synthesis with Nano Banana, and camera grammar.

label: Distributed Agentics, Concurrency & Scale Architecture
description: Architectural principles, queue-backed concurrency, KV-cache economics, memory guardian protection, and graph partitioning required to scale autonomous agent swarms and knowledge trees to millions of entities and high-throughput execution.

label: Social Attraction, Funnels & Monetization
description: Organic social distribution loops, viral hook design, Grand Slam Offer creation, value ladder architecture, VSL sales funnels, and lifecycle email automation.

label: Space Builder
description: The domain of understanding, designing, and building space systems — from orbital mechanics and propulsion through mission design, spacecraft engineering, and space economy.

label: Systems & Distributed Engineering
description: Foundations and advanced practices of scalable software architecture, distributed data systems, event-driven pipelines, and cloud-native workflows.

label: Web Design, Graphic Design & Spatial UI
description: The canon of visual aesthetics, Swiss grid systems, typographic rhythm, emotional UI/UX, responsive interaction design, and brand identity architecture.

label: SWE-bench Verified
description: Gold standard evaluation benchmark for software engineering agents resolving real-world GitHub pull requests and issues in production repositories.

label: GAIA (General AI Assistants)
description: Rigorous benchmark testing multi-modal reasoning, web browsing, code execution, and multi-step tool use for autonomous assistants.

label: WebArena
description: Realistic and reproducible web environment benchmark for evaluating autonomous visual web agents across ecommerce, CMS, and coding tools.

label: HumanEval+
description: Standardized code synthesis benchmark testing Python docstring-to-code generation with rigorous unit test suites.

label: Needle In A Haystack (NIAH)
description: Evaluation measuring an LLM's retrieval accuracy across 128k to 2M+ token contexts by placing hidden facts at varied depths.

label: AgentBench
description: Multi-dimensional benchmark evaluating LLM-as-Agent capabilities across OS terminal navigation, database querying, web browsing, and digital games.

label: Swarm Concurrency & Task Throughput Benchmark
description: Measures task completion rate (tasks/min), 429 rate-limit avoidance, peak RAM consumption, and git conflict rate under concurrent loads of 10 to 100 parallel agent workers.
